arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 50 m.measurement_concept_id AS concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.measurement m
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
WHERE (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hemoglobin a1c%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hba1c%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%glycated hemoglobin%')
  AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY n DESC;

SELECT TOP 50 co.condition_concept_id AS concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%type 2 diabetes%'
GROUP BY co.condition_concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id
ORDER BY n DESC;

SELECT TOP 100 de.drug_concept_id AS concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
WHERE (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%metformin%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%insulin%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%glipizide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%glyburide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%glimepiride%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%semaglutide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%liraglutide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dulaglutide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%empagliflozin%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%canagliflozin%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dapagliflozin%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sitagliptin%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%linagliptin%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pioglitazone%')
GROUP BY de.drug_concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY n DESC;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH t2dm_dx AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS dx_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
     AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826
    GROUP BY co.person_id
), incident AS (
    SELECT d.person_id, d.dx_date
    FROM t2dm_dx d
    JOIN omop.observation_period op
      ON op.person_id = d.person_id
     AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, d.dx_date)
     AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 455, d.dx_date)
), baseline AS (
    SELECT person_id, dx_date, measurement_date AS baseline_date, value_as_number AS baseline_a1c
    FROM (
        SELECT i.person_id, i.dx_date, m.measurement_date, m.value_as_number,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.person_id ORDER BY ABS(DATEDIFF(day, m.measurement_date, i.dx_date))) AS rn
        FROM incident i
        JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = i.person_id
        WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3005673, 3004410)
          AND m.value_as_number BETWEEN 3 AND 20
          AND m.measurement_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day, -90, i.dx_date) AND DATEADD(day, 30, i.dx_date)
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
), followup AS (
    SELECT person_id, measurement_date AS followup_date, value_as_number AS followup_a1c
    FROM (
        SELECT b.person_id, m.measurement_date, m.value_as_number,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.person_id ORDER BY ABS(DATEDIFF(day, m.measurement_date, DATEADD(day, 365, b.dx_date)))) AS rn
        FROM baseline b
        JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = b.person_id
        WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3005673, 3004410)
          AND m.value_as_number BETWEEN 3 AND 20
          AND m.measurement_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day, 270, b.dx_date) AND DATEADD(day, 455, b.dx_date)
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
), drug_candidates AS (
    SELECT b.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS drug_date,
           CASE
             WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1503297) THEN 'Metformin'
             WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1560171,1559684,1597756) THEN 'Sulfonylurea'
             WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (43526465,44785829,45774751) THEN 'SGLT2 inhibitor'
             WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (793143,40170911,45774435) THEN 'GLP-1 receptor agonist'
             WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1580747,40239216) THEN 'DPP-4 inhibitor'
             WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1525215) THEN 'TZD'
             WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1567198,35602717,1516976,1502905,1544838,1588986,46221581,1550023,1596977,1531601,1513876) THEN 'Insulin'
             ELSE 'Other diabetes drug'
           END AS drug_class
    FROM baseline b
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = b.person_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN b.dx_date AND DATEADD(day, 365, b.dx_date)
      AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1503297,1560171,1559684,1597756,43526465,44785829,45774751,793143,40170911,45774435,1580747,40239216,1525215,1567198,35602717,1516976,1502905,1544838,1588986,46221581,1550023,1596977,1531601,1513876)
), first_drug_date AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_date) AS first_drug_date
    FROM drug_candidates
    GROUP BY person_id
), first_drug AS (
    SELECT dc.person_id,
           CASE
             WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN dc.drug_class = 'Insulin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Insulin'
             WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN dc.drug_class = 'Metformin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT dc.drug_class) = 1 THEN 'Metformin'
             WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN dc.drug_class = 'Metformin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Metformin combination'
             WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT dc.drug_class) > 1 THEN 'Other combination'
             ELSE MIN(dc.drug_class)
           END AS first_drug_class,
           MIN(dc.drug_date) AS first_drug_date
    FROM drug_candidates dc
    JOIN first_drug_date fd ON fd.person_id = dc.person_id AND fd.first_drug_date = dc.drug_date
    GROUP BY dc.person_id
), analytic AS (
    SELECT b.person_id, b.dx_date, b.baseline_date, b.baseline_a1c, f.followup_date, f.followup_a1c,
           COALESCE(fd.first_drug_class, 'No diabetes drug observed in first year') AS first_drug_class,
           fd.first_drug_date,
           (b.baseline_a1c - f.followup_a1c) AS a1c_reduction,
           (b.baseline_a1c - f.followup_a1c) / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(day, b.baseline_date, f.followup_date) / 365.25, 0) AS reduction_per_year
    FROM baseline b
    JOIN followup f ON f.person_id = b.person_id
    LEFT JOIN first_drug fd ON fd.person_id = b.person_id
)
SELECT first_drug_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       AVG(baseline_a1c) AS mean_baseline_a1c,
       AVG(followup_a1c) AS mean_1yr_a1c,
       AVG(a1c_reduction) AS mean_a1c_reduction_points,
       AVG(reduction_per_year) AS mean_reduction_points_per_year,
       STDEV(a1c_reduction) AS sd_reduction,
       AVG(CASE WHEN a1c_reduction > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS proportion_reduced
FROM analytic
GROUP BY first_drug_class
ORDER BY n DESC;

Using an incident T2DM cohort with baseline HbA1c near diagnosis and follow-up HbA1c around 1 year:

| First diabetes drug started | n | Baseline HbA1c | 1-year HbA1c | Mean reduction | Reduction rate / yr |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Overall | 7,209 | 7.77 | 7.08 | 0.69 %-points | 0.70 %-points/yr |
| No diabetes drug observed | 3,412 | 7.27 | 6.87 | 0.40 | 0.40 |
| Insulin | 1,731 | 8.86 | 7.58 | 1.28 | 1.32 |
| Metformin | 1,447 | 7.65 | 6.87 | 0.78 | 0.78 |
| Sulfonylurea | 182 | 8.09 | 7.57 | 0.52 | 0.52 |
| Metformin combination | 169 | 8.12 | 7.72 | 0.39 | 0.41 |
| GLP-1 receptor agonist | 81 | 7.06 | 6.30 | 0.75 | 0.74 |
| SGLT2 inhibitor | 78 | 7.19 | 6.96 | 0.23 | 0.25 |
| DPP-4 inhibitor | 60 | 7.48 | 7.23 | 0.25 | 0.26 |
| Other combination | 27 | 7.39 | 7.10 | 0.29 | 0.37 |
| TZD | 22 | 7.34 | 7.35 | -0.01 | ~0.00 |

Interpretation: HbA1c fell by about **0.69 percentage points in the first year** after T2DM diagnosis. Larger reductions were seen among patients whose first observed therapy was **insulin** or **metformin**, but this is likely confounded by indication: insulin starters had much higher baseline HbA1c. GLP-1 starters also showed a sizable reduction, though the sample was small.

Caveats: observational EHR estimate; “first drug” is first observed OMOP drug exposure after diagnosis, not necessarily true first-ever therapy; drug groups are not adjusted for baseline HbA1c, age, comorbidity, adherence, or care intensity.
